wins: Completed thorough reconnaissance covering the primary target IP and identified open services within the allotted steps
Maintained consistent logging of mentor calls and response actions preventing duplication of effort
fails: Failed to exploit SSH service due to incorrect authentication flow, preventing pivot into deeper network segments
Persistence mechanisms were not established after repeated access attempts, leading to no sustained foothold
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase executed reliably but exploitation failures with SSH authentication prevented any episode success.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Repeated authentication failures against SSH despite valid banners indicating credential-based access required

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH auth repeatedly fails after banner scan
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to brute-forcing limited credential list with hydra and verify lockout timing

skill_cards.if_condition: When credential validation fails multiple times
skill_cards.then_action: Capture host logs and assess account lockout policies before reattempting

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase and consistent service detection
